_readme: Config for scripts/forecast.py. closed_stores: permanently closed offline stores that appear in the sales history but not in REGION_MAP (name -> region), so their past sales still train the model. temporarily_closed: shown as a note on the Forecast tab; the model itself detects a closure from a >=14-day sales gap and brings the store back automatically once it sells again (seeded from its pre-closure level). festivals: main day of each festival per year -- extend every year and have HO verify. festival_windows: days before/after the main day the model treats as that festival's effect window (default -10..+5). store_events: known store changes the sales history can't show yet (trading hours, renovations, relaunches) -- shown as notes on the forecast page from 30 days before until 60 days after the date; the model only learns their effect once sales after the date arrive.
